name: @opensite/ui
description: Foundational UI component library for OpenSite Semantic Site Builder with tree-shakable exports and abstract styling
author: OpenSite AI (https://opensite.ai)

scripts.build: pnpm run generate:exports && pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run export:registry
scripts.generate:exports: bash scripts/generate-all-exports.sh && node scripts/merge-exports.js && node scripts/create-organized-exports.js
scripts.generate:registry: pnpm run build:lib && pnpm run export:registry
scripts.prepublishOnly: pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ci
